goal: audit: Perform a comprehensive audit and mapping of the entire AI coding environment in this directory.
summary: Map the Avivmorad repo plus cloud-agent Cursor stack into a committed environment atlas
acceptanceCriteria: audit/ENVIRONMENT_MAP.md exists and links every section with a one-screen executive summary
audit/reference/ holds machine-readable inventories workers can reuse without rescanning
Each major layer (repository, Cursor config, cloud runtime, orchestration substrate) has a dedicated section file under audit/sections/
Architecture diagram in audit/ARCHITECTURE.md shows how repo, cloud VM, plugins, MCP, and orchestrate loop connect

tasks.name: bootstrap-reference-pack
tasks.scopedGoal: Bootstrap reference material for the audit tree. Scan the workspace at /agent/repos/Avivmorad and the cloud-agent VM (home ~/.cursor, /cursor/stores, installed plugins, available MCP namespaces, orchestrate CLI location). Commit under audit/reference/: (1) repo-tree.txt from `find` on the repo excluding .git, (2) cursor-plugins-inventory.md listing every installed plugin under ~/.cursor/plugins/cache with version from plugin.json when present, (3) skills-inventory.md covering ~/.cursor/skills-cursor, /cursor/stores/user/skills, and workspace rules from the agent context, (4) mcp-namespaces.json listing dynamic tool namespaces visible to agents (Github, Context7, cursor-cloud, cursor-subscriptions, cursor) with tool counts if you can enumerate via GetDynamicTools catalog, (5) cloud-runtime-snapshot.json with fields from cursor-cloud run-info and environment-info (bcId, repoUrl, model, environment ids, build id, egress policy). Do not write audit/sections or ENVIRONMENT_MAP yet. Downstream tasks must read audit/reference/ instead of repeating full discovery.
acceptance: audit/reference/ contains at least five artifact files listed in the scoped goal
repo-tree.txt reflects the current repository file list
cloud-runtime-snapshot.json includes bcId and environment build metadata

tasks.name: map-repository-surface
tasks.scopedGoal: Using audit/reference/repo-tree.txt and README.md, write audit/sections/01-repository.md (repo purpose, branch/remotes, what is in-tree vs external linked projects from README) and audit/sections/02-linked-projects.md (table of named GitHub/Vercel projects, visibility, and stack hints from README). Note explicitly that the in-repo codebase is profile-only today.
acceptance: 01-repository.md documents git remote and branch strategy
02-linked-projects.md lists MailPriority, InterviewPilot, Banger or Bot, Agent-Biz with links

tasks.name: map-cursor-stack
tasks.scopedGoal: Using audit/reference/cursor-plugins-inventory.md and skills-inventory.md, write audit/sections/03-cursor-plugins-and-skills.md covering installed marketplace plugins (orchestrate, cursor-team-kit), skill locations, workspace rules (no-inline-imports, typescript-exhaustive-switch), user skill store entries, and how agents discover skills. Include paths on this VM.
acceptance: Documents orchestrate plugin path and cursor-team-kit skills

tasks.name: map-cloud-runtime
tasks.scopedGoal: Using audit/reference/cloud-runtime-snapshot.json and mcp-namespaces.json, write audit/sections/04-cloud-agent-runtime.md (VM layers, environment build vs repo bootstrap, available MCP/subagent types from agent context) and audit/sections/05-tooling-and-cli.md (shell, node, bun for orchestrate, git, tmux policy). Document CURSOR_API_KEY/SLACK presence as boolean only, never values.
acceptance: 04-cloud-agent-runtime.md references environment build id from snapshot
05-tooling-and-cli.md documents orchestrate cli.ts path and bun requirement

tasks.name: map-orchestrate-substrate
tasks.scopedGoal: Write audit/sections/06-orchestrate-substrate.md explaining this run's .orchestrate/audit workspace (plan.json, state.json, handoffs/), branch naming orch/audit/*, planner vs worker roles, and how to rerun `bun cli.ts run --root .orchestrate/audit`. Read orchestrate SKILL.md at the cached plugin path only for accuracy; do not modify orchestrate sources.
acceptance: Describes rootSlug audit and selfAgentId lineage field
Includes the foreground run loop hygiene (exit 100 restart, exit 1 failure handoffs)

tasks.name: synthesize-master-map
tasks.scopedGoal: Produce audit/README.md (how to read the atlas), audit/ENVIRONMENT_MAP.md (executive summary + deep links to every section), and audit/ARCHITECTURE.md with a mermaid diagram of repo ↔ cloud agent ↔ plugins/MCP ↔ orchestrate loop. Fold in upstream section content; do not duplicate full inventories (link to audit/reference/ instead).
acceptance: ENVIRONMENT_MAP.md links all six section files
ARCHITECTURE.md contains at least one mermaid diagram

tasks.name: verify-environment-map
tasks.scopedGoal: Verify the environment atlas meets planner acceptanceCriteria: required files exist, links resolve, reference pack is cited, and no secret values appear in markdown. Run test -f checks and rg for cursor_ or xoxb- patterns in audit/.
tasks.verify:
## Automated
- `test -f audit/ENVIRONMENT_MAP.md && test -f audit/ARCHITECTURE.md && test -f audit/reference/cloud-runtime-snapshot.json`
- `rg -n 'cursor_[A-Za-z0-9]|xoxb-' audit/ && exit 1 || exit 0`

## Manual
- Open ENVIRONMENT_MAP.md and confirm each section link targets an existing file
- Confirm ARCHITECTURE.md mermaid renders logically
